faqs.description: Ema can seamlessly integrate with multiple document storage solutions, retrieving data from public websites and over 200 external integrations to incorporate directly into your documents. You can upload files directly to Ema, or connect it with SharePoint, Google Drive, Dropbox, Box, and OneDrive.
faqs.title: What external integrations does Ema support?

faqs.description: Ema leverages her Agentic AI mesh to learn from thousands of your past documents, trusted public sources, and enterprise data to generate accurate, contextually relevant content. Ema also accepts natural language instructions and feedback, allowing you to interact with her as you would with a human employee, improving outputs iteratively.
faqs.title: Where does Ema read from to generate accurate, relevant content?

faqs.description: Ema can generate documents, presentations, and spreadsheets, enhancing them by retrieving relevant data to create charts, tables, and images, ensuring the final content is both visually appealing and informative.
faqs.title: What are the output formats supported by Ema?

faqs.description: Standard LLMs often produce hallucinated or low-quality documents that struggle to align with user expectations. However, Ema solves these challenges by integrating specialized AI agents, real-time data, and an intuitive, collaborative user experience. Teams can co-author complex documents in real time, generate individual sections independently for greater agility, and provide continuous natural language feedback, ensuring accuracy, relevance, and speed.
faqs.title: How is Ema different from ChatGPT or any other tools out there?

faqs.description: Yes, Ema is built with robust security and governance measures, including frequent penetration tests and data protection layers. She is one of the most compliant platforms that supports standards like SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, ISO 42001, ISO 27001, GDPR, NIST, among others. Visit trust.ema.co for more details.
